Inspect the M8 (H9 Cockpit Views) engine: render structural / temporal views (overview, journal, timeline, execution) over the projected active graph. Closes the M8.2 surface

Usage: sddk dev cockpit <COMMAND>

Commands:
  view        Render a structural/temporal Cockpit view over the projected active graph (overview, journal, timeline, execution)
  obs         Render an operational Cockpit observability view over the projected active graph (providers, usage, assurance, handoff, experiments)
  diff        Compute drift between two active graph projections (M8.7). Emits added / removed / changed nodes and edges with field-level attribution. Sources can be archive manifests (`--cycle-a` / `--cycle-b`) or `ActiveGraphInput` JSON files (`--input-a` / `--input-b`)
  diff-watch  Tail drift between two active graph projections in real time (M9+ interactive drift sessions). Re-reads inputs on each tick and emits a new `DriftRow` JSON envelope whenever the content-only projection digest changes (ignoring per-tick `recorded_at` noise). Same sources as `Diff`
  digest      Compute a stable SHA-256 digest of the active graph projection (M8.8). Two kinds: `strict` (default — includes `recorded_at`, so any timestamp drift produces a different hash) and `content` (ignores `recorded_at`, only structural content participates). Sources can be an archive manifest (`--cycle`) or an `ActiveGraphInput` JSON file (`--input`)
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
